 Scorpio Shani Horoscope Today, 15 November 2026: Moon in Uttara Ashadha and Shani Retrograde Ask for Steady Work

 Neeraj Dhankher / TOI Astrology / Nov 15, 2026, 04:45 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Sunday is a day for steady work, not sudden bursts. The Moon moves through Uttara Ashadha in Capricorn, your third house of daily effort, skills and initiative. This nakshatra, the latter of the two Ashadha stars, is known for victories that come through persistence rather than luck. Capricorn is ruled by Shani, which is retrograde in Pisces, your fifth house. Together, they suggest the way forward at work lies in showing up, doing the task properly, and repeating it day after day. Tomorrow, a major shift begins, so today is ideal for preparing. A Star of Lasting Effort 
 Uttara Ashadha is ruled by the Sun, and its symbol is often described as the tusk of an elephant, steady and unbreakable. Under its influence, patient work tends to stick. You may feel less interested in shortcuts and more willing to tackle tasks that need time, such as learning a new tool, organising files or finishing a long report. Choose one such task for the coming week and start planning it tonight. Shani Wants a Rhythm 
 Shani rules your third and fourth houses, linking work habits with peace at home. Its retrograde in your fifth house asks you to review how you plan and prioritise. A simple daily routine with fixed start times, short breaks and a clear end to the workday serves you better than late nights and catch-up weekends. The Sun Comes to Your Sign Tomorrow 
 The Sun, lord of your tenth house of career, spends its last day in Libra, your twelfth, before entering Scorpio on Monday. From tomorrow, your visibility at work rises and confidence returns. Mars, your ruling planet, already sits strong in Leo, your tenth house, alongside Jupiter. A steady routine set up today will help you use that coming boost well. Join conversation

 A Deep Evening Moment 
 Tonight the Moon meets Pluto in Capricorn. You may reflect on why certain efforts in the past did not pay off. Pluto helps you let go of time-wasting habits. Mercury and Venus, both now direct, make it easier to communicate fresh plans to colleagues from midweek. What to Do Today 
 Plan a simple daily work routine for the coming week with fixed hours and short breaks. Choose one task that needs patient effort and prepare for it. Let go of one time-wasting habit you noticed recently. Rest well tonight so you can make the most of the Sun’s arrival in your sign tomorrow. Share your plans with colleagues after Wednesday. Shani Remedy for Today 
 Recite the Aditya Hridayam once at sunrise tomorrow to welcome the Sun into your sign. Donate a pair of sturdy, good-condition work shoes to a daily-wage labourer.
